title: Sloth holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M64 40 Q58 52 55 65' stroke='#d8d8e8' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='30' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='25' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M72 44 l-2 4 l4 0 z' fill='#c9184a'/>
  <!-- sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#a0785a'/>
  <!-- sloth belly -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='74' rx='15' ry='14' fill='#d4b896'/>
  <!-- sloth head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='16' fill='#b88964'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='49' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#f0dcc0'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='44' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#5a3a2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='44' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#5a3a2a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='44' r='2' fill='#1a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='44' r='2' fill='#1a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='36.5' cy='43.5' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='43.5' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='50' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#5a3a2a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 54 Q42 57 46 54' stroke='#5a3a2a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='40' r='5' fill='#b88964'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#d4b896'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='5' fill='#b88964'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#d4b896'/>
  <!-- arm holding string -->
  <path d='M58 62 Q62 56 64 50' stroke='#a0785a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- claws on holding arm -->
  <path d='M63 48 l1 -3 M65 48 l2 -3 M67 49 l2 -2' stroke='#e8d8c0' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d='M24 64 Q18 68 16 74' stroke='#a0785a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M15 74 l-1 3 M17 75 l0 3 M19 75 l1 3' stroke='#e8d8c0' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='90' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8a6448'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='90' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8a6448'/>
  <!-- foot claws -->
  <path d='M24 90 l-2 2 M26 91 l-2 2 M28 91 l-1 3' stroke='#e8d8c0' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M48 90 l-1 3 M50 91 l0 3 M52 91 l1 3' stroke='#e8d8c0' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
